verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents several install paths (pip, uv, Docker, Kubernetes) and a quick-start whose single command pulls and starts the image. Its getting-started guide promises a first AI conversation in under five minutes. Community users note very large Docker images, which can slow setup but does not contradict the one-command install. Missing for 10: the exact install command text is not shown in the evidence, there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the minutes-to-chat claim, and image size is a friction point.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes
